<header class="page-heading"><p class="eyebrow">District Court starter template</p><h1>Criminal Motion</h1><p>Use this format for a motion in a criminal case when the requested relief concerns a charge, filing, deadline, proceeding, or other criminal-case issue.</p></header>

<article class="filing-template">
  <p class="filing-template__notice"><strong>Template use.</strong> State whether the motion concerns a particular count, charge, deadline, or prior order. The governing criminal rule or statute should be identified where applicable.</p>
  <div class="filing-template__document">
    <div class="filing-template__caption"><p><strong>UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT</strong></p><p><strong>DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA</strong></p><h2>UNITED STATES OF AMERICA v. [DEFENDANT]</h2><p>Case No. [CR-________]</p></div>
    <h2>[UNITED STATES / DEFENDANT]’S MOTION FOR [RELIEF]</h2>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Count / issue</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Identify affected count, charge, filing, or proceeding]</span></div>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Authority</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Rule, statute, prior order, or other basis]</span></div>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Relevant background</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Set out only the facts necessary to decide the motion.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Argument</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Explain why the requested criminal-case relief is warranted.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Relief requested</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[State the exact order requested.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Respectfully submitted</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Name]<br>[Office / counsel status]<br>[Date]</p></section>
  </div>
</article>
